//: tsx-only tsconfig for the two-tenant isolation harness (scripts/test-tenant-isolation.ts and scripts/harness/**). It extends tsconfig.scripts.json and adds runtime aliases for the three Next.js modules the SERVER ACTION layer touches. The harness's whole premise is that it drives the real actions in src/app/actions/, and those actions transitively reach next/headers (cookies -> getCurrentUser), next/navigation (redirect, which is how every access guard says no) and next/cache (revalidatePath). None of them resolve in a plain Node/tsx process. Aliasing them here — rather than importing the actions through some wrapper — keeps the code under test completely unmodified. `paths` fully REPLACES the parent's, so every mapping tsconfig.scripts.json declares is repeated.
